shape.offset.hint: Where the middle of the shape sits, measured from the bone's own origin.
shape.rotation.hint: How the shape is turned on the bone, in degrees.
capsule.radius.hint: How thick the capsule is, in blocks.
capsule.length.hint: The whole length of the capsule, round ends included.
capsule.rotation.hint: How the shape is turned on the bone, in degrees. A capsule stands on its Y.
box.half_extents.hint: Half the size of the box, so 0.5 is a block across.
sphere.radius.hint: How big the ball is, in blocks.
body.shape.hint: What the body is shaped like, in the space of the bone it hangs on.
body.density.hint: Kilograms per cubic metre. Flesh and bone together are a little denser than water.
body.linear_damping.hint: How quickly the body loses speed on its own. Higher settles it sooner.
body.angular_damping.hint: How quickly the body stops spinning on its own.
body.gravity.hint: How much gravity pulls on this body. 0 leaves it floating, 2 makes it fall twice as hard.
body.friction.hint: How much the body grips what it slides along.
body.restitution.hint: How much the body bounces off what it hits. 0 is a sack, 1 is a ball.
collision.with_rig.hint: Whether this body may hit the other bodies of the same model at all.
collision.ignores.hint: Bones this body always passes through, whatever else is set here.
collision.pushes_out.hint: Push apart the bodies this one already overlaps where the model stands. Off by default.
collision.push.hint: How hard the body resists what it touches. 1 is solid, lower lets other bodies sink into it and climb out slowly, 0 lets them pass straight through.
axis.min.hint: How far the bone may turn one way, in degrees. Leave both at zero to lock the axis.
axis.max.hint: How far the bone may turn the other way, in degrees.
limits.x.hint: How far the bone may turn around its own X, in degrees.
limits.y.hint: How far the bone may turn around its own Y, in degrees.
limits.z.hint: How far the bone may turn around its own Z, in degrees.
joint.parent.hint: The bone whose body this one hangs from. Empty means the nearest one above it.
joint.pivot.hint: Where on this bone the joint sits, measured from the bone's own origin.
